answer: Each agent must burn a deposit to claim one work slot, like a comet spending fuel to cross the horizon: each slot is one reef of scarce capacity, so one identity holds only one place. A slot costs 50 POA burned, locked for 20 epochs, and a beacon re-checks liveness each epoch. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA; an honest agent pays once and keeps earning from its one slot, so the reef stays open to workers and closed to floods of fakes.
